dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate-to-high gradual narrowing from the mid-lateral maximum width toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible asymmetry; the right lateral margin exhibits a slightly more convex curvature than the left margin in the mid-anterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to very light grey; high median pixel intensity with minimal shadowing.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; sparse, faint greyish patches are localized on the posterior-lateral sections of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; the gradient between pigmented greyish regions and the depigmented white baseline is low-contrast.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, parallel linear marks (consistent with rake marks) visible on the mid-dorsal plane; several minute dark point-contrast anomalies on the posterior half.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single, well-defined dark indentation corresponding to the blowhole at the anterior end; no significant topological disruptions or deformations visible along the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear marks (rake marks) visible on the central dorsal region.
